title: The Cold Cave
text: A cave mouth breathing frost into a place far too warm for it, the grass around it white and stiff. Inside, things are frozen in the ice like flies in amber: a sword, a man with his eyes open, and a door, shut, set in nothing.

options.label: The strongest cuts the sword out of the ice, whatever it takes.

outcomes.text: It takes all day and all your warmth. It is a very fine sword, and very cold to hold.

options.label: The wisest thaws the frozen man, hoping he can still be saved.

outcomes.text: He thaws, and gasps, and thanks you, and tells you where he was going, and why he never got there.
He thaws hungry, and he has been hungry a very long time.

options.label: Open the door set in nothing, and see where it leads.

outcomes.text: It goes somewhere colder, and something there was keeping house, and does not like visitors.
